answers.otherText:
Lead decision, TJ may reverse: adopt the exact source-only continuation in [plan section 48](/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#document-plan), revision `fd1f8e74-58a7-4815-b096-1d07067ca187`.

The existing P2P/Mining writer `3730ad68-e373-4c8a-84df-2e11327b86a5` may use one implementation pass and one correction pass, at most 45 minutes from the first production edit, from clean `664cc55a807719b8a17336efcc2d4f9efb0bc253` on this task's existing branch/worktree. Scope remains `vanguard/network/` only. Consume this persisted answer before editing; record actual pickup and the first edit separately. No further routine lead round is needed within this allowance.

Apply the guard at the shared argv boundary after child-context validation: sample the authenticated original remaining lifetime once, require it to be strictly positive immediately before the runner, and pass that same remainder. Preserve consumed uncertainty, original phase/end origins, cleanup reserve, fixed argv, one-use delivery/names, exact exit witnesses and settlement confirmation.

Correct the connected callback's subprocess keyword contract and lost complete/settle/close expectations to 3/0/3. Acceptance must observe actual injected effects, timestamps and journal dispositions. Context preparation at or beyond cutoff must cause zero runner calls/effects; a timely control must receive a positive timeout. Require valid long 17/25/39/41/43 completion, late/timeout and lost-reply recovery, replay refusal and independently eligible cleanup. Preserve substituted/expired deadlines, delayed activation, cleanup 44–53 and separate 54 controls. A callback TypeError cannot satisfy a negative case.

Retain the known-bad candidate, both original reviewer probes and first failures. Run affected connected checks and the complete source suite on a stable index; reuse unaffected evidence with attribution. Refreeze dependent bindings, commit the owned delta with the required Paperclip coauthor trailer, and publish one exact packet with authenticated readback. P2P then obtains and consumes changed-artifact Platform and independent Security assessments on this issue. Source acceptance remains unconfirmed until those assessments.

Stop at 45 minutes/two passes, unresolved trust or primitive, live privilege need, or a consensus/privacy/shared-source boundary; publish an honest partial at that stop. Protected installation/PID1/accounting/terminal work and installed/native operations remain outside this allowance. Preserve all caps, pins, null capabilities, empty qualification registries, formal Core decision/count 2, subsequent Security, separate exact grants, two fresh admissions and disabled public launch. This decision changes no execution stage or hold and supplies no runtime grant.

Needs TJ: None.
